title: GTO: Great Teacher Onizuka
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Eikichi Onizuka, a 22-year-old ex-gang member, becomes a teacher for crude reasons but takes on a notoriously troubled middle school class. Using unorthodox, sometimes illegal and risky methods, he reaches each student one by one and battles a rigid school system.
life_message: A good life means showing up for young people who have been failed, even by breaking the rules.

content.note: Fights, gangs and risky stunts (Wikipedia: 'illegal and life-threatening' methods, 'violence and menace'); AniList Gangs, Terrorism 73%, Delinquents.
Bullying, a teacher's mysterious death, terrorism arc (Wikipedia; AniList Bullying, Tragedy; MangaUpdates Abuse, Bullying).
Protagonist peeps up skirts and pursues sex; love-hotel scene (Wikipedia); 'frequently sexist' (Thompson, via Wikipedia); AniList Ecchi, Nudity.
'Smutty' dialogue (Thompson, via Wikipedia); crude humor (to verify).
Bullying, abuse and a teacher's breakdown (Wikipedia; MangaUpdates Abuse, Bullying; AniList Bullying 76%).
Teacher uses illegal and life-threatening methods (Wikipedia); delinquent behavior (AniList Delinquents).

delivery.evidence: Thompson (Wikipedia reception): smutty comedy that at best approaches social satire; Onizuka's methods carry it (to verify).
delivery.note: Criticism of a rigid school system comes through Onizuka's unorthodox interventions within a comedy.

winners_losers: The rule-breaking teacher and the students he saves win; rigid administrators and indifferent adults lose. Sympathy goes to the outsider.
